newsitem.title: USA: FOCUS- Weak gasoline demand raises API inventories.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS- Weak gasoline demand raises API inventories.

text.p: Weekly American Petroleum Institute (API) data Tuesday showed a surprisingly bearish decline in demand for gasoline and distillates, analysts said.

"If the market was looking for positive numbers to build on they were not in this report," said Tom Knight, a trader with Fina Inc in New Jersey. "It's safe to assume these numbers are not too friendly."

Traders and analysts said the API data were bearish for the entire energy sector, noting that the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) futures market appeared to anticipate the figures by selling off near the close.
